name: request_doctor_callback
description: Use when the hospital wants to speak to the referring doctor before deciding, or asks clinical questions that the patient summary does not answer. After it returns, tell them the doctor will call them back on this number within about two minutes, thank them, and end the call.
pre_call_message: One moment, I'm alerting the doctor.

attempt_id.description: Internal attempt reference from the call context. Filled in automatically; never ask for it and never say it.

reason.description: What they want to discuss with the doctor, in a few words.

contact_person.description: Name or role of the person the doctor should ask for, if given.

callback_number.description: Only if they asked to be called on a different number: that number, digits only. Otherwise leave empty.

to_number.description: The number you called. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
